protocol.holdout: Locked 20% test set (seed 42), stratified on the joint CAD/LAD/LCX/RCA label pattern; patterns with < 5 patients merged into the nearest frequent pattern (Hamming distance). The test set is evaluated exactly once, after every modelling decision (features, models, hyper-parameters, weights, calibration, thresholds) was frozen on the development set. Only the deployed ensemble and the pre-specified clinical baseline are scored on it.

test_set_history.note: First and only evaluation of the v1.0.0 models.

Re-scored after an independent code review found a calibration defect (Platt scaling, ensemble weight and thresholds had been fitted on out-of-fold margins of differently tuned fold models, so the map did not match the scale of the deployed components). The same review switched hyper-parameter tuning from ROC-AUC to log-loss (a proper scoring rule; ROC-AUC tuning had driven C to the edge of its range). Both changes and the cross-fitted CV estimate were specified and checked on the development set only; no feature, model family, search space or selection rule was changed in response to test results.

protocol.cv: Development set: repeated stratified 5-fold x 10 cross-validation per target (50 outer folds), identical folds for all models (paired comparisons). Imputation and scaling are fitted inside each training fold (scikit-learn pipelines).
protocol.tuning: Nested CV for lr_l2, lr_core, lr_l1, lr_elasticnet, svm_rbf, knn, xgboost: RandomizedSearchCV (fixed seed, neg_log_loss) over an inner stratified 5-fold split inside every outer training fold. Final component hyper-parameters searched on the whole development set with repeated stratified 5-fold x 3; untuned models use literature defaults from training.yaml.
protocol.ensemble: m = w*m_LR + (1-w)*m_XGB in log-odds space; the logistic variant (L2/L1/elastic net/clinical core) with the best nested-CV ROC-AUC is used; w chosen on a 0.05 grid by pooled out-of-fold log-loss after Platt calibration, using out-of-fold margins of components with the deployed (final) hyper-parameters. The reported CV metrics of the ensemble are cross-fitted: for every outer fold the logistic variant, w, Platt parameters and threshold are re-chosen on the other folds of that repeat only.
protocol.calibration: Platt scaling p = sigmoid(a*m + b) fitted by maximum likelihood on pooled out-of-fold ensemble margins of components with the deployed hyper-parameters (same outer folds), so the map matches the deployed margin scale.
protocol.threshold: Decision threshold = Youden's J maximiser on the same pooled out-of-fold calibrated probabilities (F1-optimal threshold also reported); CV threshold metrics use a threshold chosen without the scored fold. Leaderboard F1/accuracy use a fixed 0.5 threshold for comparability.
protocol.final_model: Component hyper-parameters searched on the whole development set (repeated stratified 5-fold x 3), components refitted on the full development set; the deployed models never saw the test set.
protocol.bootstrap: Test-set 95% CIs: 2000 stratified bootstrap resamples (percentile method), threshold held fixed at its development-set value.
protocol.baseline: Pre-specified clinical baseline: lr_core on Age, Sex, Typical Chest Pain, DM, HTN (nested-CV tuned; test threshold = Youden's J on out-of-fold probabilities with its final hyper-parameters), to quantify what the full clinical/ECG/lab/echo panel adds.
protocol.explainability: Exact SHAP in the ensemble's log-odds space: linear SHAP (w.r.t. the dev mean) for the logistic component, float64 path-dependent TreeSHAP (node cover) for XGBoost, combined linearly; additivity asserted to 1e-6.

ablations.protocol: Paired comparison on identical repeated stratified folds; fixed hyper-parameters (logistic {'C': 0.1, 'l1_ratio': 0.0}, XGBoost {'n_estimators': 200, 'max_depth': 3, 'learning_rate': 0.05, 'subsample': 0.8, 'colsample_bytree': 0.6, 'min_child_weight': 2.0, 'reg_lambda': 1.0}); score = per-fold ROC-AUC of an equal-weight LR+XGB margin ensemble; adopt if mean gain over affected targets >= 0.005.

analysis.note: Descriptive validation analyses; nothing in the deployed model (model.json, thresholds, calibration) depends on them.

robustness.method: Monte-Carlo repeated hold-out: 200 random 80%/20% splits of all patients, stratified on the joint CAD/LAD/LCX/RCA pattern (as the locked split). In every split the complete deployment recipe is re-run on the development part only - final hyper-parameter search (RandomizedSearchCV, log-loss), 10 x 5-fold out-of-fold margins -> ensemble weight, Platt calibration and Youden threshold, refit - and scored once on the split's test part. The clinical baseline is re-fitted the same way.
frozen: feature encoding and dropped constant columns
model families and the per-target logistic variant
hyper-parameter search spaces and every selection rule
robustness.fixed_split: the locked seed-42 split; its values are the published test metrics

reproduction.description: the harness run on the locked split must reproduce the deployed test probabilities

robustness.percentile: mid-rank percentile of the locked split's value within the Monte-Carlo distribution
robustness.sensitivity: the same splits were also run with frozen hyper-parameters (robustness.<target>.hyperparameter_sensitivity)
robustness.caveat: Test parts overlap across splits (and with the locked test set), so the spread describes split-to-split variability of a 61-patient evaluation, not independent replications; no choice of the deployed model depends on this analysis.

modality_ablation.method: Development-set repeated stratified cross-validation of cumulative (demographics -> +risk factors -> +symptoms -> +exam -> +ECG -> +labs -> +echo), leave-one-modality-out and single-modality feature sets on identical folds; score = per-fold ROC-AUC. The locked test set is not used.
modality_ablation.model: equal-weight log-odds ensemble of L2 logistic regression (C = 0.1, l1_ratio = 0) and XGBoost (n_estimators = 200, max_depth = 3, learning_rate = 0.05, subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.6, min_child_weight = 2, reg_lambda = 1); fixed hyper-parameters of training.yaml -> ablations, identical for every feature set
modality_ablation.folds: repeated stratified 5-fold x 10 per target (the leaderboard folds when n_repeats matches)
modality_ablation.ci: Nadeau-Bengio corrected resampled t interval over folds (variance x (1/J + n_test/n_train)); deltas are paired per fold
modality_ablation.multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each family per target (cumulative steps; leave-one-out)

subgroups.method: Performance of the same predictions within subgroups. OOF = cross-fitted development-set predictions (5-fold x 10, every choice re-made without the scored fold; repeats pooled, per-fold cross-fitted thresholds). Test = deployed model on the locked test set at the deployed threshold.
subgroups.ci: 95% percentile intervals from 2000 stratified bootstrap resamples of patients within the subgroup (OOF: cluster bootstrap - a resampled patient keeps all repeats)
subgroups.reference_level: delta_roc_auc_vs_reference compares each level with the factor's largest development-set level
subgroups.not_estimable: a class-conditional metric is null when its class has fewer than 3 patients in the subgroup
subgroups.small_n: small_n = fewer than 30 patients or fewer than 10 in either class; estimates are unstable and descriptive only
subgroups.caveat: Exploratory and under-powered: no subgroup-specific threshold, recalibration or claim of (un)fairness is derived; sex and diabetes are also model inputs.
